summary: This is an 8-K (Items 5.03, 8.01, 9.01) filed by GlobalTek Ventures, Inc. reporting a pure name change from Ameritek Ventures, Inc. The board and majority voting holder approved; no stockholder vote was needed under Nevada law. No consideration, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a routine corporate event with no special-situation characteristics. The registrant is the issuer effecting a name change only; shares and par value are unaffected. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or similar event. The filing is a standard current report of an administrative amendment, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
